suggested_change: Criterion 1: Define explicit score ranges per status (Unknown 1-3, Partial 4-6, Identified 7-9, Confirmed 10). Criterion 2: Define 'regression' as downgrade >2 points without documented reason change in source data; allow score adjustment if evaluation criteria are explicitly restated. Criterion 3: Specify Competition 6/10 requires at least one buyer-articulated dissatisfaction or threat; absence of detail = max 3/10. Criterion 4: Require next steps format: [Action verb] + [Owner] + [Deliverable] + [Date]; vague verbs alone are insufficient.
